title: rosa × collina var. dumetorum
intro: Rosa × collina var. dumetorum, commonly known as the Sweetbriar rose, is a deciduous shrub native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and relieve menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × collina var. dumetorum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
